vocabulary.meaning: adj. 未经同意的，非自愿的（多指性接触）
v. 持续留存，迟迟不散
adj. 令人毛骨悚然的，恐怖的
adj. 前所未有的，空前的
n. 集中行动，闪电式攻势
n. 千钧一发，侥幸脱险
adj. 妄想的，脱离现实的
n. 失宠，受冷落（尤指惹伴侣不高兴）

subtitles.en: Good to be with you.
subtitles.zh: 很高兴和大家见面。

subtitles.en: I'm Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 我是托尼·多库皮尔。

subtitles.en: The breaking news right now.
subtitles.zh: 现在插播突发新闻。

subtitles.en: Was it radical indoctrination?
subtitles.zh: 这是激进思想灌输吗？

subtitles.en: The Omani national who allegedly tried to hijack and crash that plane loaded with Israeli passengers may have terror ties, according to Israel's prime minister, investigators still searching for a motive.
subtitles.zh: 据以色列总理称，这名阿曼籍男子被指试图劫持并坠毁那架载有以色列乘客的飞机，可能与恐怖主义有关联，调查人员仍在寻找作案动机。

subtitles.en: Also tonight, outrage at Cornell, students holding a public hearing on the university's handling of that alleged frat gang rape, what the alleged victim did in the days after to document what she says happened.
subtitles.zh: 今晚还有康奈尔大学引发众怒，学生们就校方处理那起据称兄弟会轮奸案的方式举行公开听证会，据称的受害者在事后几天做了什么来记录她所说的事情。

subtitles.en: Severe weather outbreak.
subtitles.zh: 恶劣天气暴发。

subtitles.en: MAN 1: Structure just got hit.
subtitles.zh: 有建筑刚被击中。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: Tornadoes, and flash flooding struck the central US, more than 100 million at risk tonight.
subtitles.zh: 龙卷风和山洪暴发袭击了美国中部，今晚超过一亿人面临风险。

subtitles.en: Christa is alive right now.
subtitles.zh: 克里斯塔现在还活着。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: Failed execution-- a Tennessee woman now in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections meant to kill her, what went wrong?
subtitles.zh: 执行死刑失败——田纳西州一名女子在两次本应致命的注射后幸存，目前情况危急，到底哪里出了问题？

subtitles.en: The moment Florida deputies rescue a woman trapped in a burning car, what happened next.
subtitles.zh: 佛罗里达州警员救出一名被困在燃烧汽车里的女子的瞬间，接下来发生了什么。

subtitles.en: And a race against time rescue in Oregon after a fisherman found himself pinned under a boulder, how he called for help.
subtitles.zh: 还有俄勒冈州一场与时间赛跑的救援，一名渔民被压在巨石下，他是如何求救的。

subtitles.en: Hey, guys.
subtitles.zh: 嘿，大家好。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: And The Good Stuff, nothing but nets where they're needed most.
subtitles.zh: 还有“好东西”环节，把蚊帐送到最需要的地方。

subtitles.en: ANNOUNCER: From CBS News headquarters in New York, this is the CBS Evening News with Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 这里是纽约 CBS 新闻总部，欢迎收看托尼·多库皮尔主持的《CBS晚间新闻》。

subtitles.en: And good evening.
subtitles.zh: 晚上好。

subtitles.en: We begin tonight with the heroism on board that nearly doomed flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv on Wednesday, the co-pilot stabbing the captain and causing the plane to plummet toward the desert below.
subtitles.zh: 今晚我们从周三那架险些坠毁的迪拜飞往特拉维夫航班上的英勇行为说起，副驾驶刺伤机长，导致飞机朝下方沙漠急坠。

subtitles.en: But the wounded captain, seen here in new video, somehow managed to unlock the cockpit door, allowing a small group of passengers to push in, pull up on the controls, and then subdue the attacker using cords from a headset.
subtitles.zh: 但新视频中受伤的机长设法打开了驾驶舱门，让一小群乘客冲进去，拉起操纵杆，然后用耳机线制服了袭击者。

subtitles.en: Our senior foreign correspondent Imtiaz Tyab reporting tonight from Tel Aviv.
subtitles.zh: 我台资深驻外记者伊姆蒂亚兹·提亚布今晚从特拉维夫发回报道。

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: On the cabin floor, Captain Smit Machchhar, the pilot hailed as a hero, can be heard asking for help.
subtitles.zh: 在客舱地板上，被誉为英雄的机长斯米特·马奇哈尔在求救。

subtitles.en: SMIT MACHCHHAR: My head is spinning.
subtitles.zh: 我头很晕。

subtitles.en: It's hurting.
subtitles.zh: 很疼。

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: The cell phone camera keeps rolling as Saudi first responders help the wounded Indian captain off the FlyDubai plane, the bloodied co-pilot accused of attacking him, seen on his knees.
subtitles.zh: 手机镜头继续拍摄，沙特急救人员帮助受伤的印度籍机长走下 FlyDubai 飞机，被控袭击他的副驾驶满身血迹，跪在地上。

subtitles.en: Those chaotic scenes follow terror in the skies after the co-pilot, who CBS News has learned is of Omani origin, allegedly stabbed the captain inside the cockpit, with preliminary flight data indicating the plane then dropped 14,000 feet in less than 30 seconds.
subtitles.zh: 在这些混乱场面之前，天空中经历了恐怖一刻。CBS新闻获悉，这名原籍阿曼的副驾驶涉嫌在驾驶舱内刺伤机长，初步飞行数据显示，飞机随后在不到30秒内下降了14000英尺。

subtitles.en: Adam Polo was on board with his wife and children.
subtitles.zh: 亚当·波罗和妻子孩子都在飞机上。

subtitles.en: Was there ever a moment where you felt like you might not make it?
subtitles.zh: 你有没有哪一刻觉得自己可能撑不过去了？

subtitles.en: Absolutely.
subtitles.zh: 当然有。

subtitles.en: Absolutely, of course.
subtitles.zh: 当然有，肯定的。

subtitles.en: It's terrifying.
subtitles.zh: 太可怕了。

subtitles.en: And when you start to hear people scream, they're stabbing the-- we didn't know that there's replacement pilots on the plane.
subtitles.zh: 当你开始听到人们尖叫，说他们在刺人——我们当时不知道飞机上还有替补飞行员。

subtitles.en: MAN 2: You won't sleep.
subtitles.zh: 你会睡不着。

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: Despite his wounds, Israeli officials say, Captain Machchhar managed to unlock the cockpit door.
subtitles.zh: 以色列官员说，尽管受伤，马奇哈尔机长还是设法打开了驾驶舱门。

subtitles.en: One passenger says he briefly pulled back on the controls.
subtitles.zh: 一名乘客说，他曾短暂拉回操纵杆。

subtitles.en: Then two reserve pilots traveling on board took over, safely landing in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.
subtitles.zh: 随后机上两名备用飞行员接手，将飞机安全降落在沙特塔布克。

subtitles.en: For families still in their seats, like Hila Evron, she told CBS Mornings, it felt like her time with her sons was near their last.
subtitles.zh: 对仍坐在座位上的家庭来说，比如希拉·埃夫龙，她告诉《CBS早间新闻》，那一刻感觉她和儿子们的时间快走到尽头了。

subtitles.en: He just start to yell, Mom, I love you.
subtitles.zh: 他突然开始大喊：“妈妈，我爱你。”

subtitles.en: And that was the moment that I realized that my kid actually separating from me from the world.
subtitles.zh: 就是在那一刻，我意识到我的孩子实际上正在和我、和这个世界分离。

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: But the crisis has raised huge questions about aviation security and how this could have happened.
subtitles.zh: 但这场危机引发了关于航空安全以及这一切如何发生的巨大疑问。

subtitles.en: Speaking to Fox News, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu suggested the attacker co-pilot had, quote, "Islamist radical indoctrination."
subtitles.zh: 以色列总理内塔尼亚胡在接受福克斯新闻采访时表示，发动袭击的副驾驶经历了“伊斯兰主义激进灌输”。

subtitles.en: It looks like he had been radicalized.
subtitles.zh: 看起来他已经被激进化了。

subtitles.en: I think it's too early to say whether he had any connections with Iran or with anyone else.
subtitles.zh: 我觉得现在说他是否与伊朗或其他任何人有联系还为时过早。

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: Captain Machchhar has since been airlifted to a hospital in the UAE, where Indian embassy officials say he's recovering well.
subtitles.zh: 马奇哈尔机长随后被空运到阿联酋一家医院，印度大使馆官员说，他恢复得不错。

subtitles.en: And the United Arab Emirates has launched an investigation into what happened on the FlyDubai flight that put 174 lives at risk, including whether there may be possible links to terrorism.
subtitles.zh: 阿联酋已对 FlyDubai 航班上这起危及174条生命的事件展开调查，包括是否可能与恐怖主义有关。

subtitles.en: But the central question now is, how did a weapon enter the cockpit, and was it more than just luck as well as quick-thinking by passengers that prevented what could have been a deadly disaster?
subtitles.zh: 但现在核心问题是：武器是怎么进入驾驶舱的？而阻止这场可能致命灾难的，是否不只是运气和乘客的机敏反应？

subtitles.en: Tony.
subtitles.zh: 托尼。

subtitles.en: Imtiaz, thank you very much.
subtitles.zh: 伊姆蒂亚兹，非常感谢。

subtitles.en: We also know more tonight about what happened in the days after a young woman says she was raped by multiple men at a Cornell University frat house, including how she documented the alleged attack.
subtitles.zh: 今晚我们还了解到更多关于一名年轻女子称自己在康奈尔大学兄弟会被多名男子强奸之后几天发生的事，包括她如何记录这起据称的袭击。

subtitles.en: Here's CBS's Tom Hanson.
subtitles.zh: 请听 CBS 记者汤姆·汉森报道。

subtitles.en: TOM HANSON: CBS News has obtained copies of a number of documents related to the investigation into an alleged gang rape at a Cornell University frat house.
subtitles.zh: CBS新闻获得了与康奈尔大学兄弟会一起据称轮奸案调查相关的多份文件副本。

subtitles.en: The former student says she felt, quote, "like bait.
subtitles.zh: 这名前学生说，她觉得自己像诱饵。

subtitles.en: I felt like lions around me.
subtitles.zh: 我觉得周围都是狮子。

subtitles.en: It just was a totally debilitating place to be in."
subtitles.zh: 那是一种让人彻底崩溃的处境。

subtitles.en: She told campus investigators that she consumed ketamine that night, a drug that can leave users immobile, even incapacitated, and described the feeling as "lights are on, but nobody's home.
subtitles.zh: 她告诉校园调查人员，她那晚服用了氯胺酮，这种毒品会让人无法动弹，甚至失去行动能力，她形容那种感觉就像灯亮着，但家里没人。

subtitles.en: Your brain is not functioning at its proper level."
subtitles.zh: 你的大脑没有在正常水平运转。

subtitles.en: The Title IX report also revealed this statement from one of the accused male students, quote, "I was sorry that maybe if it wasn't consensual and she was victimized, I was sorry for not stopping it, just sorry that I felt like if something bad happened, I didn't stop it."
subtitles.zh: 《教育法修正案第九条》报告还披露了其中一名被指控男学生的陈述：“我很抱歉，如果那并非双方自愿，她受到了伤害，我很抱歉没有阻止；我只是抱歉，我觉得如果发生了不好的事情，我没有去阻止。”

subtitles.en: According to a transcript of her interview with campus investigators, she says she collected evidence, including the dress she wore that night and pictures of her bruises, and that two days after the alleged sexual assault, she went to a campus clinic to treat an infection.
subtitles.zh: 根据她与校园调查人员谈话的记录，她说自己收集了证据，包括当晚穿的裙子和淤青照片，并且在据称的性侵发生两天后，她去校园诊所治疗感染。

subtitles.en: Her attorney says she told doctors it was contracted in a traumatic way, and instead of being referred for a rape kit, she was advised to seek therapy.
subtitles.zh: 她的律师说，她告诉医生感染是在创伤性经历中染上的，但医生没有建议她做性侵取证检查，反而建议她寻求心理治疗。

subtitles.en: Her internal processing went from denial to shame and ultimately, acceptance that she had been raped by people that she thought were her friends, he said.
subtitles.zh: 他说，她的内心经历了从否认到羞耻，最终接受自己被她以为是朋友的人强奸的过程。

subtitles.en: Late this afternoon, a student organized town hall on sexual violence was held on campus.
subtitles.zh: 今天下午晚些时候，一场由学生组织的关于性暴力的公开讨论会在校园举行。

subtitles.en: I'm also speaking as a fellow Jane Doe.
subtitles.zh: 我也是作为一名‘无名氏’女生在发声。

subtitles.en: TOM HANSON: Frustration and concern were on full display.
subtitles.zh: 汤姆·汉森：沮丧和担忧都摆在了明面上。

subtitles.en: STUDENT: We need to hold each other accountable.
subtitles.zh: 学生：我们得互相监督、彼此负责。

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: Among those attending Akshara Keshri, a Cornell junior.
subtitles.zh: 伊姆蒂亚兹·提亚布：参加的人里有阿克莎拉·凯什里，康奈尔大学的大三学生。

subtitles.en: I know plenty of women like Jane Doe who do feel unsafe at frat houses.
subtitles.zh: 我认识很多像‘无名氏’那样的女生，她们在兄弟会房子里确实觉得不安全。

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: And have you talked to any of your girlfriends about this issue, and what are they saying?
subtitles.zh: 伊姆蒂亚兹·提亚布：那你有和你的女生朋友们聊过这件事吗？她们怎么说？

subtitles.en: They're saying the same thing.
subtitles.zh: 她们说的都一样。

subtitles.en: They're just scared.
subtitles.zh: 她们就是害怕。

subtitles.en: We're all scared.
subtitles.zh: 我们都很害怕。

subtitles.en: We're more mad as well at the administration.
subtitles.zh: 我们对学校管理层也更生气了。

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: She says this is not just a Cornell problem.
subtitles.zh: 伊姆蒂亚兹·提亚布：她说这不仅仅是康奈尔的问题。

subtitles.en: But when women report issues to cops around the world, they are either not acted upon or simply ignored.
subtitles.zh: 但世界各地女性向警察报案时，不是没人受理，就是干脆被无视。

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: Do you think the onus should solely fall on women to keep each other safe?
subtitles.zh: 伊姆蒂亚兹·提亚布：你觉得保护彼此安全的责任，应该只落在女性身上吗？

subtitles.en: No, it should not be "protect your daughter."
subtitles.zh: 不，不应该是‘保护好你的女儿’。

subtitles.en: It should be "educate your son."
subtitles.zh: 而应该是‘教育好你的儿子’。

subtitles.en: And I will die on this hill.
subtitles.zh: 这一点我死都不会让步。

subtitles.en: And, Tony, here's an alarming statistic.
subtitles.zh: 而且，托尼，这里有个令人震惊的数据。

subtitles.en: A Cornell survey last year found more than a third of undergraduate women reported non-consensual sexual contact since entering school.
subtitles.zh: 康奈尔去年一项调查发现，超过三分之一的本科女生报告说，入学后经历过非自愿的性接触。

subtitles.en: Now, the university declined our request for an interview.
subtitles.zh: 校方拒绝了我们的采访请求。

subtitles.en: We also reached out to all of the accused.
subtitles.zh: 我们也联系了所有被指控的人。

subtitles.en: We heard back from lawyers for two, who denied the allegations, Tony.
subtitles.zh: 我们收到了其中两人的律师回复，他们否认了这些指控，托尼。

subtitles.en: Tom, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 汤姆，谢谢。

subtitles.en: Thunderstorms are threatening the central US tonight following an outbreak of flash floods and tornadoes yesterday.
subtitles.zh: 昨天突发山洪和龙卷风之后，今晚雷暴正威胁美国中部。

subtitles.en: CBS's Jason Allen reports tonight from Fort Worth, Texas.
subtitles.zh: CBS 记者贾森·艾伦在得克萨斯州沃斯堡报道。

subtitles.en: JASON ALLEN: Moisture from two powerful hurricanes in the Pacific rushed into the Southern and Central US.
subtitles.zh: 贾森·艾伦：来自太平洋两场强飓风的水汽涌入美国南部和中部。

subtitles.en: The system spun up tornadoes in Kansas and flash floods in Texas and Nebraska, with rainfall rates in some areas reaching 4 inches per hour.
subtitles.zh: 这个天气系统在堪萨斯州催生出龙卷风，在得州和内布拉斯加州引发山洪，部分地区的降雨强度达到每小时4英寸。

subtitles.en: In Fort Worth, a bus plowed through city streets, flooding in heavy rain, while cars started to float.
subtitles.zh: 在沃斯堡，一辆公交车在暴雨积水中艰难驶过市区街道，一些小汽车开始漂起来。

subtitles.en: Firefighters waded in to rescue a woman from her car and carried her to higher ground.
subtitles.zh: 消防员蹚水过去，从车里救出一名女子，并把她转移到高处。

subtitles.en: In Omaha, Nebraska, this truck fishtailed right in front of a car before sliding across several lanes of highway.
subtitles.zh: 在内布拉斯加州奥马哈，这辆卡车在一辆小汽车前突然甩尾，随后横滑过好几条车道。

subtitles.en: In Kansas, a tornado ripped apart this barn in a matter of seconds.
subtitles.zh: 在堪萨斯州，一场龙卷风几秒钟内就把这座谷仓撕成了碎片。

subtitles.en: Here in Texas, the extreme weather comes after one of the longest dry streaks in Dallas and Fort Worth, 77 consecutive days without significant rainfall.
subtitles.zh: 在得州，这次极端天气发生前，达拉斯和沃斯堡刚经历了最长的干旱期之一，连续77天没有明显降雨。

subtitles.en: We just watched one of these big logs just rushed downstream, and it's blocking the drainage ways, along with a bunch of trash that is built up.
subtitles.zh: 我们刚刚看到一根大原木被冲向下游，堵住了排水通道，旁边还有一堆堆积起来的垃圾。

subtitles.en: And that's causing all of these creeks, these rivers, to overflow, blocking some pretty major roads like this one.
subtitles.zh: 这导致这些溪流、河流全都漫出来，堵塞了一些像这样的主要道路。

subtitles.en: The Texas Hill Country was also bracing for flooding, a reminder of the storms that caused deadly flash floods in July.
subtitles.zh: 得州丘陵地区也在防备洪水，这让人想起7月那场造成致命山洪的风暴。

subtitles.en: The house has been flooded twice so far.
subtitles.zh: 这栋房子到现在已经被淹了两次。

subtitles.en: Floods are evil and nasty, and you don't understand how disruptive they are.
subtitles.zh: 洪水又恶毒又烦人，你根本不知道它能把生活搅得多乱。

subtitles.en: Some cities in the Texas Hill Country have received more than 7 inches of rain in the last 24 hours, and there is still a flood watch that's in effect through tomorrow night, as all of that water starts to drain into streams and creeks.
subtitles.zh: 得州丘陵地区的一些城市在过去24小时内降雨量已经超过7英寸，而且洪水警戒仍将生效到明天晚上，因为所有这些水正开始排入溪流和小河。

subtitles.en: Jason, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 贾森，谢谢。

subtitles.en: More storms are firing up tonight across the Southern Plains as well, and they are pushing east with more than 100 million Americans under a flood threat through the weekend.
subtitles.zh: 今晚南部平原也有更多风暴生成，它们正向东推进，到周末超过1亿美国人面临洪水威胁。

subtitles.en: Meteorologist Rob Marciano tracking it all, as always.
subtitles.zh: 气象学家罗布·马西亚诺一如既往地追踪所有情况。

subtitles.en: Rob, good evening.
subtitles.zh: 罗布，晚上好。

subtitles.en: Hey, Tony, this has become a really wide-reaching system all the way to the Great Lakes.
subtitles.zh: 嘿，托尼，这已经变成了一个影响范围非常广的系统，一直延伸到五大湖地区。

subtitles.en: Chicago, you've been out of the rain for a couple of days now, and we do still have some flash-flood warnings that are in effect for Tyler, Texas, for San Antonio, although those have shifted a little bit to the east.
subtitles.zh: 芝加哥，你们那边已经停雨几天了，不过得州泰勒和圣安东尼奥的山洪警报仍然生效，只是稍微往东移了一点。

subtitles.en: But all in all, this is a 1,300-plus mile stretch of moisture.
subtitles.zh: 但总的来说，这是一条绵延1300多英里的水汽带。

subtitles.en: Houston, you're going to get it next.
subtitles.zh: 休斯敦，下一个就轮到你们了。

subtitles.en: And then we'll get another round of this as we go through tomorrow in some of the same areas.
subtitles.zh: 然后明天，一些同样的地区还会再经历一轮。

subtitles.en: So we'll get it redistributed into Little Rock and then down the I-10 corridor as well, a level 2 out of 4 as opposed to 3 out of 4, so slightly less tomorrow.
subtitles.zh: 所以它会重新分布到小石城，然后沿着I-10走廊南下；风险等级从4级中的3级降到2级，所以明天会稍微轻一些。

subtitles.en: But still, that front was there.
subtitles.zh: 但那个锋面还停在那里。

subtitles.en: It's going to hang around on top Gulf moisture, so anywhere from 2 to as much as 7 inches of rain into some of these areas.
subtitles.zh: 它会停留在墨西哥湾水汽上方，所以这些地区的降雨量会在2英寸到7英寸之间。

subtitles.en: And this will linger into the weekend.
subtitles.zh: 这种情况还会持续到周末。

subtitles.en: Meanwhile, also in the weekend, Southern California into the heat, triple-digit stuff, near it, as you head towards Saturday and Sunday.
subtitles.zh: 与此同时，周末南加州也会热起来，接近华氏一百多度，周六周日都会。

subtitles.en: So summer not wanting to quit there as we head now into October.
subtitles.zh: 所以都已经进入10月了，夏天在那里还是不肯退场。

subtitles.en: Tony.
subtitles.zh: 托尼。

subtitles.en: Rob, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 罗布，谢谢。

subtitles.en: We turn now to that failed execution in Tennessee.
subtitles.zh: 现在转向田纳西州那次失败的死刑执行。

subtitles.en: Convicted killer Christa Pike said she was ready to die, ready to be free, as she put it, but instead, she somehow survived two doses of a supposedly lethal drug.
subtitles.zh: 已定罪杀人犯克丽斯塔·派克说，她已经准备好赴死，按她的说法，准备好解脱；但没想到她挺过了两剂本该致命的药物，活了下来。

subtitles.en: Here's CBS's Skyler Henry.
subtitles.zh: 下面是 CBS 记者斯凯勒·亨利报道。

subtitles.en: SKYLER HENRY: It was supposed to be routine, but the botched execution of Christa Pike has Tennessee officials now searching for answers.
subtitles.zh: 斯凯勒·亨利：这本应是一次例行程序，但克丽斯塔·派克的执行搞砸了，田纳西州官员现在正在查找原因。

subtitles.en: There was no reason to expect it to not work.
subtitles.zh: 没有理由认为它会不起作用。

subtitles.en: But something didn't go well or right last night.
subtitles.zh: 但昨晚就是出了岔子，不对劲。

subtitles.en: SKYLER HENRY: At 7:27 PM, Pike was seen by witnesses strapped to a gurney.
subtitles.zh: 斯凯勒·亨利：晚上7点27分，目击者看到派克被绑在轮床上。

subtitles.en: They watched as pentobarbital was administered.
subtitles.zh: 他们目睹了戊巴比妥被注射进去。

subtitles.en: Pike complained about pain in her arm.
subtitles.zh: 派克抱怨手臂疼痛。

subtitles.en: At 8:05, the curtains were closed, but witnesses continued to hear her snoring, until they were ushered out at 8:53.
subtitles.zh: 8点05分，窗帘被拉上了，但目击者仍能听到她的鼾声，直到8点53分他们被带离。

subtitles.en: Pike has spent more than 30 years on death row for the 1995 gruesome murder of her classmate, Colleen Slemmer.
subtitles.zh: 派克因1995年残忍杀害同学科琳·斯莱默而在死囚牢房待了30多年。

subtitles.en: Pike's lawyers argued she should be spared because of untreated mental illness and severe childhood sexual abuse they say wasn't adequately presented to a sentencing jury.
subtitles.zh: 派克的律师辩称，她应该被免于死刑，因为她患有未治疗的精神疾病，并遭受严重的童年性虐待，而这些情况没有被充分提交给量刑陪审团。

subtitles.en: Her lawyers now say she's in critical condition.
subtitles.zh: 她的律师现在说她情况危急。

subtitles.en: This is a completely unprecedented event.
subtitles.zh: 这是一起完全前所未有的事件。

subtitles.en: Christa Pike is the only person we know of who survived the administration of lethal doses of injection drugs.
subtitles.zh: 克里斯塔·派克是我们所知道的唯一一个在注射了致死剂量注射药物后活下来的人。

subtitles.en: This is Tennessee's second failed execution attempt this year, and it comes just four years after an independent review exposed several repeated failures by the state to properly test those lethal injection drugs.
subtitles.zh: 这是田纳西州今年第二次执行死刑失败，而四年前一份独立审查刚刚揭露该州在检测这些注射死刑药物方面多次失职。

subtitles.en: Tony.
subtitles.zh: 托尼。

subtitles.en: Skyler, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 斯凯勒，谢谢你。

subtitles.en: President Trump today launched a campaign blitz for Republicans in the run up to the midterm elections, with some unexpected early stops in deep-red Oklahoma and Texas as well.
subtitles.zh: 特朗普总统今天为共和党启动了一场中期选举前的竞选闪电战，还意外地提前在深红的俄克拉何马州和得克萨斯州停留。

subtitles.en: CBS's Nancy Cordes reports tonight from Denton, Texas.
subtitles.zh: CBS新闻的南希·科德斯今晚从得克萨斯州登顿市报道。

subtitles.en: But I can't get the word out.
subtitles.zh: 可我没法把消息传出去。

subtitles.en: NANCY CORDES: President Trump traveled here to Denton, Texas for two reasons.
subtitles.zh: 南希·科德斯：特朗普总统来到得克萨斯州登顿市有两个原因。

subtitles.en: The first was to promote his tariffs.
subtitles.zh: 第一是宣传他的关税政策。

subtitles.en: I'm really here for Ken.
subtitles.zh: 我其实是为肯来的。

subtitles.en: NANCY CORDES: The second was to shore up support for Texas Senate candidate Ken Paxton, who told donors that Trump's last trip here didn't help, according to audio obtained by The New York Times.
subtitles.zh: 南希·科德斯：第二是为得州参议员候选人肯·帕克斯顿争取支持；据《纽约时报》获得的音频，帕克斯顿曾告诉捐款人，特朗普上次来这里并没有帮助。

subtitles.en: KEN PAXTON: When we did that convention, it dropped our numbers.
subtitles.zh: 肯·帕克斯顿：我们开那次大会时，我们的支持率下降了。

subtitles.en: Everybody's numbers dropped.
subtitles.zh: 每个人的数字都下降了。

subtitles.en: NANCY CORDES: This could help explain why, sky-high prices for gas and diesel that led Texas Governor Greg Abbott to declare a statewide disaster this week.
subtitles.zh: 南希·科德斯：这或许能解释为什么本周汽油和柴油价格高得离谱，以至于得州州长格雷格·阿博特宣布全州进入灾难状态。

subtitles.en: At least 15 states are offering some form of fuel tax relief as the war with Iran drags on.
subtitles.zh: 随着与伊朗的战争持续，至少15个州正在提供某种形式的燃油税减免。

subtitles.en: And yet Trump claimed incorrectly today that "prices are way down from what Biden and the Dumocrats left us."
subtitles.zh: 然而特朗普今天错误地声称“价格比拜登和民主党那帮蠢货留给我们时低多了”。

subtitles.en: I give us an A+ on the government, on economics, on everything.
subtitles.zh: 我给我们在政府、经济、所有方面都打A+。

subtitles.en: We're about-- NANCY CORDES: Trevor Theriot wouldn't go quite that far today, but he did say things are going well for him.
subtitles.zh: 我们差不多——南希·科德斯：特雷弗·特里奥特今天不会把话说得那么满，但他确实说自己的情况很不错。

subtitles.en: We're growing at 8%.
subtitles.zh: 我们在以8%的速度增长。

subtitles.en: To me, that's success.
subtitles.zh: 对我来说，这就是成功。

subtitles.en: NANCY CORDES: Theriot owns a medical device manufacturing company here in Denton.
subtitles.zh: 南希·科德斯：特里奥特在登顿经营一家医疗器械制造公司。

subtitles.en: He says the research and development credits in Trump's Big Beautiful Bill helped him a lot and that tariffs have incentivized him to build more of his products here in the US.
subtitles.zh: 他说，特朗普的《大而美法案》中的研发税收抵免对他帮助很大，关税也激励他把更多产品放在美国生产。

subtitles.en: I will say, 200% tariff would be impossible.
subtitles.zh: 我得说，200%的关税是行不通的。

subtitles.en: But the 10% to 25% that we've seen lately still dynamically works for our company.
subtitles.zh: 但我们最近看到的10%到25%的关税，对我们公司来说仍然非常有效。

subtitles.en: President Trump, who just wrapped up here, has been considering a temporary ban on US diesel exports to help bring down fuel prices.
subtitles.zh: 刚结束这里活动的特朗普总统一直在考虑暂时禁止美国柴油出口，以帮助压低燃油价格。

subtitles.en: But there could be downsides, like the possibility of global price shocks.
subtitles.zh: 但可能会有负面影响，比如可能引发全球价格冲击。

subtitles.en: And so for now, he's holding off, Tony.
subtitles.zh: 所以目前他还在观望，托尼。

subtitles.en: Nancy, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 南希，谢谢你。

subtitles.en: We turn now to a rescue in Oregon in which Siri, that virtual assistant from Apple, helped save a man's life.
subtitles.zh: 现在来看俄勒冈州的一场救援，苹果的虚拟助手Siri帮助救了一名男子的命。

subtitles.en: Carter Evans has our details.
subtitles.zh: 卡特·埃文斯带来详细报道。

subtitles.en: And a warning, some of these images may be disturbing.
subtitles.zh: 提醒一下，有些画面可能会让人不适。

subtitles.en: POLICE: I've located him.
subtitles.zh: 警方：我找到他了。

subtitles.en: CARTER EVANS: Look closely as the police drone video zooms in.
subtitles.zh: 卡特·埃文斯：仔细看，警方无人机视频正在拉近镜头。

subtitles.en: That's 28-year-old Joe Little pinned under a giant boulder.
subtitles.zh: 那是28岁的乔·利特尔被压在一块巨大的石头下。

subtitles.en: A boulder started slipping.
subtitles.zh: 一块巨石开始滑动。

subtitles.en: He tried to catch himself.
subtitles.zh: 他试图撑住自己。

subtitles.en: He got thrown in the air, and it flew on top of him.
subtitles.zh: 他被抛到空中，石头飞压在他身上。

subtitles.en: CARTER EVANS: Little's mom, Mindy, says he was trapped on a jetty where he was fishing alone in Hammond, Oregon Saturday, and the tide was rising.
subtitles.zh: 卡特·埃文斯：利特尔的妈妈明迪说，他周六在俄勒冈州哈蒙德独自钓鱼时被困在防波堤上，而且潮水正在上涨。

subtitles.en: He thought he was going to die.
subtitles.zh: 他以为自己会死。

subtitles.en: CARTER EVANS: Police would have never even known to look for him.
subtitles.zh: 卡特·埃文斯：警方原本根本不会知道要去找他。

subtitles.en: But Siri saved the day.
subtitles.zh: 但Siri扭转了局面。

subtitles.en: He was wearing those behind-the-ear headphones, and he was able to say, "Siri, call 911."
subtitles.zh: 他当时戴着那种耳挂式耳机，所以能说：“Siri，打911。”

subtitles.en: CARTER EVANS: The drone eventually guided in rescuers, who freed him from the boulder.
subtitles.zh: 卡特·埃文斯：无人机最终引导救援人员赶到，把他从巨石下救了出来。

subtitles.en: A Coast Guard helicopter hoisted him to safety.
subtitles.zh: 一架海岸警卫队直升机把他吊到了安全地带。

subtitles.en: POLICE: Still the survivor aboard the aircraft.
subtitles.zh: 警方：幸存者仍在飞机上。

subtitles.en: CARTER EVANS: And flew him to the hospital, where he's recovering from a fractured skull and a broken jaw.
subtitles.zh: 卡特·埃文斯：然后把他送到医院，他正在那里从颅骨骨折和下颌骨骨折中恢复。

subtitles.en: He just went fishing.
subtitles.zh: 他只是去钓鱼。

subtitles.en: It's a miracle my son is alive.
subtitles.zh: 我儿子还活着真是个奇迹。

subtitles.en: CARTER EVANS: A remarkable rescue set in motion by Siri.
subtitles.zh: 卡特·埃文斯：一场由Siri触发的非凡救援。

subtitles.en: POLICE: Nice and slow.
subtitles.zh: 警方：慢一点，稳一点。

subtitles.en: CARTER EVANS: Carter Evans, CBS News.
subtitles.zh: 卡特·埃文斯：卡特·埃文斯，CBS新闻。

subtitles.en: Still ahead on the broadcast tonight, liftoff for NASA's new mission and the astronaut who will be up there in orbit during a milestone here on Earth.
subtitles.zh: 今晚节目稍后：NASA的新任务即将升空，还有那位在地球这里迎来里程碑时会身处轨道的宇航员。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: Here's a look 260 miles above Earth, as the Dragon spacecraft has reached the International Space Station for a six-month stay.
subtitles.zh: 我们来看看地球上方260英里的画面，龙飞船已经抵达国际空间站，准备在那里驻留六个月。

subtitles.en: It's got four astronauts on board, including one with another pretty big mission back on Earth.
subtitles.zh: 飞船上有四名宇航员，其中一位在地球上还有一件挺大的事。

subtitles.en: CBS's Mark Strassmann has our story.
subtitles.zh: CBS的马克·斯特拉斯曼为您报道。

subtitles.en: SPEAKER: Liftoff.
subtitles.zh: 发射升空。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMAN: Crew 13's six-month mission above Earth lifted off with zero complications-- well, one for Canadian astronaut, Josh Kutryk.
subtitles.zh: 第13号机组为期六个月的地球轨道任务顺利升空——好吧，对加拿大宇航员乔什·库特里克来说有个小情况。

subtitles.en: His wife, Heather, is due with their third child around Thanksgiving.
subtitles.zh: 他的妻子希瑟预计在感恩节前后生下他们的第三个孩子。

subtitles.en: He'll be 260 miles off the planet.
subtitles.zh: 届时他会在距地球260英里的太空。

subtitles.en: Boy, girl?
subtitles.zh: 男孩还是女孩？

subtitles.en: JOSH KUTRYK: We don't know.
subtitles.zh: 我们不知道。

subtitles.en: We like surprises.
subtitles.zh: 我们喜欢惊喜。

subtitles.en: Should be able to figure that out by now.
subtitles.zh: 现在想查应该早能查出来了。

subtitles.en: Will it be hard to miss the moment?
subtitles.zh: 错过那个时刻会不会很难受？

subtitles.en: Of course.
subtitles.zh: 当然会。

subtitles.en: But I think when we're older, we'll look back on it fondly because of the uniqueness and the excitement.
subtitles.zh: 但我想等我们老了，回想起来会觉得很难忘，因为这件事很特别、很让人兴奋。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMAN: Ask any husband.
subtitles.zh: 问问任何一位丈夫就知道了。

subtitles.en: The space station could have become Kutryk's doghouse.
subtitles.zh: 空间站本可能让库特里克惹老婆不高兴。

subtitles.en: But Heather Kutryk supports his childhood dream of space.
subtitles.zh: 但希瑟·库特里克支持他儿时的太空梦。

subtitles.en: Not exactly a plan, but it's a great thing.
subtitles.zh: 不完全是计划之中的事，但这是件很棒的事。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMAN: Along with their children, Peter, he's seven, and Anna, she's five.
subtitles.zh: 和他们在一起的还有孩子：七岁的彼得和五岁的安娜。

subtitles.en: Maybe I'm delusional.
subtitles.zh: 也许我太乐观了。

subtitles.en: Maybe it'll hit me when he's actually gone.
subtitles.zh: 也许等他真的走了，我才会难受起来。

subtitles.en: But so far, I feel like we're going to be great.
subtitles.zh: 但到目前为止，我觉得我们会没事的。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMAN: No one can promise him family leave in space, but NASA will connect the Kutryks virtually for the big moment.
subtitles.zh: 没人能保证他在太空能休家庭假，但NASA会在那个重要时刻通过视频把他们一家人连在一起。

subtitles.en: We will definitely have to look at time off around that time frame, too.
subtitles.zh: 我们肯定也得看看那段时间能不能请假。

subtitles.en: We're going to have to talk about the parental leave part.
subtitles.zh: 我们还得谈谈育儿假这部分。

subtitles.en: MARK STRASSMAN: Josh Kutryk's space mission is a shared family sacrifice.
subtitles.zh: 乔什·库特里克的太空任务是一家人的共同牺牲。

subtitles.en: It's exceptionally important, and I hope that my new child looks at it as such, as making some sacrifice, taking some risk, but doing so in the name of public service and the name, of my case, for Canada.
subtitles.zh: 这件事格外重要，我希望我的新孩子也能这样看待它：做出一些牺牲、承担一些风险，但这是为了公共服务，就我而言，是为了加拿大。

subtitles.en: Over the decades, astronauts in space have missed the birth of a child three other times.
subtitles.zh: 过去几十年里，宇航员在太空中错过孩子出生的情况还有过三次。

subtitles.en: Tony, the family life they said goodbye to going up is very different than the one they say hello to coming back.
subtitles.zh: 托尼，他们升空时告别的家庭生活，和回来时迎接的家庭生活会大不一样。

subtitles.en: It sure is, Mark.
subtitles.zh: 确实如此，马克。

subtitles.en: Thank you very much.
subtitles.zh: 非常感谢。

subtitles.en: We're back with a close call rescue in Orange County, Florida.
subtitles.zh: 接下来是佛罗里达州奥兰治县的一起惊险救援。

subtitles.en: Two sheriff's deputies rushed in to free a woman whose car caught fire after she hit a tree last week.
subtitles.zh: 上周，一名女子开车撞树后车辆起火，两名警员冲上去把她救了出来。

subtitles.en: One doused the flames with a fire extinguisher.
subtitles.zh: 一人用灭火器扑灭火焰。

subtitles.en: The other checked on the driver, then both yanked her out on the count of 1, 2, pull.
subtitles.zh: 另一人查看司机情况，然后两人数着“一、二、拉”，合力把她拽了出来。

subtitles.en: Up next, The Good Stuff, a man working to improve his community one basketball court at a time.
subtitles.zh: 接下来是《好事情》，讲一个人一个球场接一个球场改善社区的故事。

subtitles.en: We are back with The Good Stuff tonight, a story of a man who has made it his mission to make sure every basketball hoop in his community has a net on it, and he's not waiting around for someone else to hang it.
subtitles.zh: 今晚《好事情》继续，故事里的这个人把确保社区里每个篮球筐都有球网当成自己的任务，而且他不等别人来挂。

subtitles.en: Just yesterday, in fact, Craig Campanella hung his 77th outdoor net of the year, well on his way to a goal of 100 basketball nets in 2026.
subtitles.zh: 事实上就在昨天，克雷格·坎帕内拉挂上了他今年第77个户外球网，朝着2026年挂100个篮球网的目标稳步前进。

subtitles.en: Hey, guys.
subtitles.zh: 嘿，各位。

subtitles.en: I want to put a net up there for you.
subtitles.zh: 我想给你们那儿挂个球网。

subtitles.en: Can you give me 10 minutes?
subtitles.zh: 能给我十分钟吗？

subtitles.en: Yeah, I got you.
subtitles.zh: 行，交给我吧。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: He's been doing it after work and on weekends for months now, traveling around with a ladder and a spreadsheet of hoops in need, mostly around his neighborhood in Queens, New York.
subtitles.zh: 几个月来，他一直在下班后和周末做这件事，带着梯子和一张记录需要球网的篮筐清单四处跑，主要是在他住的纽约皇后区附近。

subtitles.en: And the local basketball players, they absolutely love it.
subtitles.zh: 当地的篮球爱好者们都非常喜欢。

subtitles.en: Because whenever I do it, they tell me how appreciative they are.
subtitles.zh: 因为每次我挂网时，他们都会告诉我有多感激。

subtitles.en: They say, oh my god, thank you so much.
subtitles.zh: 他们会说，天哪，太谢谢你了。

subtitles.en: And some of them cheer.
subtitles.zh: 有些人还会欢呼。

subtitles.en: Yay!
subtitles.zh: 耶！

subtitles.en: It's so great.
subtitles.zh: 太棒了。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: But of all the problems of the world, why this one?
subtitles.zh: 但世界上有那么多问题，为什么选这件事？

subtitles.en: Well, for no other reason than that beautiful sound of a basketball falling through a net and the fact that Craig knows it makes people happy.
subtitles.zh: 不为别的，就因为篮球穿过球网时那好听的声音，以及克雷格知道这能让人开心。

subtitles.en: There are more important problems in the world, but this is something that I can do that is helpful and I enjoy doing.
subtitles.zh: 世界上有更重要的问题，但这件事我能做、有帮助，而且我也喜欢做。

subtitles.en: So it's how I choose to give back.
subtitles.zh: 所以我选择用这种方式回馈社会。

subtitles.en: After giving back on his own at $10.99 per net, Craig now says others are donating too, and he's got the perfect name for his little program, Nothing But Nets.
subtitles.zh: 起初他自掏腰包，每个球网10.99美元；克雷格说现在也有其他人捐款了，而且他给自己的小项目起了个绝佳名字，叫“只要球网”。

subtitles.en: That's another day in America.
subtitles.zh: 这就是美国的又一天。

subtitles.en: I'm Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 我是托尼·多库皮尔。

subtitles.en: Thank you for watching.
subtitles.zh: 感谢收看。

subtitles.en: For all of us here at CBS News, good night.
subtitles.zh: 我们CBS新闻全体同仁祝您晚安。

subtitles.en: See you right back here tomorrow.
subtitles.zh: 明天同一时间再见。
